title: Detach MeshInstance3D from its mesh on destruction to prevent destruction-order bug

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

Basically without this fix, destruction happens in this order:
1. MeshInstance3D releases its surface materials. If nothing else is owning them, they are destroyed.
2. Its parent class, VisualInstance3D, [asks the renderer](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e7b12e749220a75ef87e800e080bd2732ad46854/scene/3d/visual_instance_3d.cpp#L218) to destroy the rendering instance.
3. but before destroying that instance, the renderer processes pending updates (which can then [try to access](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/servers/rendering/renderer_scene_cull.cpp#L4431) the already-destroyed materials)


## Additional information

This is the exact path (though there are probably other code paths that can encounter this bug):

1. `update_dirty_instances` is [called here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e7b12e749220a75ef87e800e080bd2732ad46854/servers/rendering/renderer_scene_cull.cpp#L4434).
2. which [processes each dirty instances](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e7b12e749220a75ef87e800e080bd2732ad46854/servers/rendering/renderer_scene_cull.cpp#L4379).
3. then the material is [read here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e7b12e749220a75ef87e800e080bd2732ad46854/servers/rendering/renderer_scene_cull.cpp#L4237).
4. [Asks](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e7b12e749220a75ef87e800e080bd2732ad46854/servers/rendering/renderer_scene_cull.cpp#L4242) whether it casts shadows.
5. and [material_casts_shadows](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e7b12e749220a75ef87e800e080bd2732ad46854/servers/rendering/renderer_rd/storage_rd/material_storage.cpp#L2641) asks for the actual material which will then fail:
```cpp
bool MaterialStorage::material_casts_shadows(RID p_material) {
	Material *material = material_owner.get_or_null(p_material);
	ERR_FAIL_NULL_V(material, true);
```

## Reproduction

[mesh-des.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33202500/mesh-des.zip)

I encountered this on my own machine/godot fork (win64), but I tested it on github codespaces and got the error as well.
(use `--detach-first` to get the behavior of this fix)
